spanish: Y labró dos tablas de piedras como las primeras, y madrugó Moisés en la mañana, y subió a monte Sinai conforme a lo que mandó Jehová a él, y tomó en su mano dos tablas de piedras.
notes: Each token is present once: hewed two stone tablets like the former ones, Moses rose early in the morning, went up to Mount Sinai as Jehovah commanded him, and took two stone tablets in his hand.
